_comment: Drop into ~/Library/Application Support/Claude/claude_desktop_config.json (macOS), %APPDATA%\Claude\claude_desktop_config.json (Windows), or ~/.config/Claude/claude_desktop_config.json (Linux). Then start the game with `./gradlew :fabric:runClient -Dagent.mcpPort=39800 -Dagent.rpcPort=39801` and restart Claude Desktop.
